newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas rises in winter, well bid and offered.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas rises in winter, well bid and offered.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures traded 75 lots in three separate deals on Monday morning as prices firmed.

November traded at 13.50 pence, up by 0.025 pence from the previous settlement level, after earlier trading down at 13.40 pence. And December traded a single time at 15.30 pence, up by 0.10 pence from Friday's settlement.
Bids and offers were posted in all 12 contract months at the close of the morning session. Front month August was bid at 9.60 pence and offered at 9.90 pence at the close.

The flexibility mechanism over the weekend saw two system sells on Saturday at a System Marginal Price (SMP) of 0.296 pence a kiloWatt hour, or around 8.67 pence a therm. The System Average Price (SAP) was 0.2966 p/kWh, or 8.69 p/th.
By Sunday, Transco said the 7-day rolling average SAP was 0.3365 p/kWh (9.86 p/th), while the 30-day average SAP was 0.3979 p/kWh (11.66 p/th).
There was no flexibility mechanism activity on Friday or Sunday.
